# Archive — do not edit

These are the team's original single-file programs. `robot/` holds the same
code split into one file per run, and `tests/check.py` proves the split
version sends the robot exactly the same commands.

- `team-2026-11-18/MissionMenu.py` — **the program that ran at the Nov 14
  qualifier** (saved in the Pybricks backup of Nov 18). This is what `robot/`
  matches today.
- `team-2026-11-18/Mission2_v1_0.py` — M02 Exploding Seeds, solved after the
  qualifier and tested as its own program. `robot/run_seeds.py` matches it.
- `before-qualifier-2026-11-07/MissionMenu-11-7-26.py` — an older version
  saved to Google Drive on Nov 7.
- `older/` — earlier versions from Google Drive.

If something goes badly wrong right before a match, `team-2026-11-18/MissionMenu.py`
is the fallback: import it into Pybricks Code by itself and run it.
